The tool-picker text says Station Control publishes native titles and behavioral annotations and groups tools by ai.kontour/tool-group. declare_pull_request is registered through the same registry: title 'Declare pull request', readOnlyHint false (mutating), group Tasks (the pull_request pattern was added to the Tasks group; pinned by station-control-declare-pull-request-tools.test.ts). It is therefore outside the Read only shortcut. No claim changed.
